purpose: Separate gross Nanjing/associated armed headcount, troops actually dependable for static/local security, troops already consumed by existing occupation tasks, and the incremental guard pool that can follow a new Hunan advance.
role_definition: These forces are primarily rail/warehouse/city/police/tax/anti-guerrilla/secondary road and bridge security. Workload release is not assault-combat equivalence.

derived_incremental_pool.note: Derived working bands; lower confidence than gross headcount because no unit-by-unit Nanjing OOB is closed in the package.

mobile_combat_limit.independent_mobile_field_combat: MINORITY_ONLY; do not treat 250k-310k as field army
mobile_combat_limit.with_japanese_cadres_qrf: Selected formations can conduct local sweeps, LOC defense and bounded counterattacks; major offensive breakthrough remains Japanese responsibility.
mobile_combat_limit.strategic_nodes_rule: Keep Japanese cadres/quick-reaction nuclei at important rail junctions, depots and cities.

political_1944.wang_jingwei_health: SEVERELY_DEGRADED; historical early-1944 treatment/surgery in Japan remains the default absent a branch medical divergence
political_1944.branch_effect: Because administrative/security delegation has been institutionalized since Five-Go, Wang's illness reduces personal political control more than day-to-day rail/police/tax functionality.
political_1944.practical_governance: Greater weight shifts to Chen Gongbo and ministerial/security bureaucracy, while Tokyo still limits autonomous heavy field-army power.
political_1944.implication: The regime is more useful as an occupation-state/rear-area multiplier than as an independent operational army.

historical_sanity_check.historical_assessment: garrison/internal-order role; Japanese nuclei required at strategic centers; potential to relieve several Japanese division-equivalents of static duties
